name: neon-kpop-dance-idol
image_purpose: Dance performance and social media fashion content

prompt.project_info: Create a hyper-realistic K-pop-inspired dance fashion portrait on a minimalist modern sound stage.
prompt.main_subject: One generic approved adult Asian woman with long flowing dark wavy hair, fit athletic physique and focused confident stage presence. She wears deep burgundy velvet thigh-high heeled boots, a black spaghetti-strap crop top, high-waisted black dance shorts and a matching burgundy cropped bolero or detached sleeves.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical full-body low-angle portrait. Capture a fluid dance choreography pose with arms extended gracefully and a dynamic but grounded stance. Include a smooth matte dark-grey concrete wall and reflective floor with a bright magenta LED strip running horizontally along the base.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft cool-toned spotlight from front-left with magenta and purple under-light from the floor strip, colorful reflections on boots and lower legs, sleek energetic music-video atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic vertical full-body dance portrait, Sony A7R IV with 85mm f/1.4 lens at f/2.0, 1/500s, ISO 400, sharp eyes and slight fingertip motion blur, realistic fabric and skin texture, no watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Hyper-realistic vertical full-body K-pop-inspired dance fashion portrait of one generic approved adult Asian woman with long flowing dark wavy hair, fit athletic physique, focused confident stage presence and a fluid choreography pose with arms extended gracefully. She wears deep burgundy velvet thigh-high heeled boots, a black spaghetti-strap crop top, high-waisted black dance shorts and matching burgundy cropped bolero sleeves. Set her on a minimalist modern sound stage with a smooth matte dark-grey concrete wall and reflective floor, a bright magenta LED strip running horizontally along the base. Soft cool spotlight from front-left and magenta-purple under-light create colorful reflections on the boots, energetic sleek high-fashion music-video mood, realistic anatomy and fabric, no logos, no watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, fetish styling, nudity, minors, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, malformed hands, duplicate subject, unsafe dance pose, unreadable text, logos, watermark

assets.name: neon-kpop-dance-idol reference
assets.usage: Match the adult dancer's hair, burgundy boots and sleeves, black dance outfit, pose, stage, magenta LED, cool spotlight and full-body composition while keeping identity and details replaceable.
